The '''Splendid Drawing of a Fish''' is a {{Special}} [[Memento]].

__TOC__
== Obtaining ==
A '''Splendid Drawing of a Fish''' is obtainable by completing a list of objectives given by {{NPCSprite|Centauri}} to test different aspects of the Backwater Bayou update.

Upon completion of all objectives, the following message is displayed:
{{Dialogue|
&f&l ALPHA TASK COMPLETE
&aCongratulations on completing all the objectives on the Alpha Checklist! Your commemorative item will be delivered to you shortly. Thanks for testing!
&7 Your reward: &cSplendid Drawing of a Fish
}}

The '''Splendid Drawing of a Fish''' is delivered to players' islands via {{NPCSprite|Jerry}}.
